description: Use Logto (self-hosted or cloud) as the auth provider for Convex React and Expo apps. Session mode keeps the Logto refresh token in a Convex component and pushes revocation to open clients. Bridge mode keeps Logto's SDK in the browser. Both hand Convex the OIDC ID token. Includes a signed webhook user sync and OIDC back-channel logout.
rules: convex-logto hands Logto's OIDC ID token to Convex. It uses the ID token on purpose. Logto access tokens are typed `at+jwt` and Convex rejects them.

Session mode is the recommended mode. The Convex deployment is the OAuth client: create a Traditional web app in Logto, `app.use(logto)` from `convex-logto/convex.config` in convex/convex.config.ts, set LOGTO_ENDPOINT, LOGTO_APP_ID and LOGTO_CLIENT_SECRET on the deployment, re-export all eleven functions from `logtoSessionApi(components.logto)` in convex/auth.ts, and mount `ConvexLogtoSessionProvider` from `convex-logto/react-session` with `sessionApi={api.auth}`. No Logto SDK and no Logto config in the bundle.

Bridge mode is the alternative: a Single page app in Logto, `@logto/react` installed, `ConvexLogtoProvider` from `convex-logto/react` with static `config={{ endpoint, appId }}` (or `configQuery={api.logto.config}` backed by `logtoConfigQuery()`). Revocation waits for the ID token to expire.

Import server helpers (logtoAuthConfig, logtoSessionApi, assertSubjectHasActiveSession, logtoConfigQuery, logtoSync, registerLogtoWebhook, registerLogtoBackchannelLogout, createLogtoSessionCookieHandler, assertOrganizationRole) from `convex-logto`. The React entries `convex-logto/react-session` and `convex-logto/react` are ESM-only. Expo uses `convex-logto/native-session` or `convex-logto/native`.
Pass `{ initialAuthTokenReuse: true }` to `ConvexReactClient`. Without it Convex refetches a token on every page load, which spends a Logto refresh grant each time.

There is no JWT template, algorithm, or JWKS URL to configure; Convex discovers them over OIDC. Logto signs with ES384 by default, which Convex rejects silently, so rotate the tenant's OIDC signing key to RSA once.
Peer dependencies: convex and react. Install with `npm i convex-logto`; bridge mode also needs `@logto/react` (or `@logto/rn` on Expo).
